title: Claims-Free Credit on the CondoGuard Realignment Rate
content:
**How does claims-free time affect the rate for a CondoGuard Coverage A realignment?** On the CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy, the claims-free multiplier on the realignment rate measures the whole months from the date of the latest claim payment issued on the CondoGuard policy (or, when none was ever issued, from the policy's first inception date) to the day of the realignment: it is 0.90 for 60 or more whole months, 0.95 for 36 to 59 whole months, and 1.00 for fewer than 36 whole months. The multiplier is applied to the tier's Coverage A rate per 1,000 USD, before the full-year realignment charge is rounded. Where that rate carries more than one multiplier, they are first multiplied together and then applied once to the tier's rate; none of them acts on the result of another.

**Which date starts the count?** The date of the latest claim payment issued on this CondoGuard policy, of any coverage part. When the policy has never had a claim payment, the count starts on the policy's first inception date.

| Whole months from the latest claim payment (or first inception) to the realignment | Claims-free multiplier |
|---|---|
| 60 or more | 0.90 |
| 36 to 59 | 0.95 |
| fewer than 36 | 1.00, no claims-free adjustment |

**Worked questions (hypothetical policies).**

- *Latest claim payment 59 whole months before the realignment?* 0.95. *60 whole months?* 0.90.
- *Latest claim payment 35 whole months before?* 1.00. *36?* 0.95.
- *No claim payment ever, first inception 72 whole months before?* The count runs from first inception, 72 whole months, 0.90.
- *No claim payment ever, first inception 20 whole months before?* 20 whole months, 1.00.
